info.name: The Walking Dead: World Beyond
info.plot: A heroic group of teens sheltered from the dangers of the post-apocalyptic world leave the safety of the only home they have ever known and embark on a cross-country journey to find the one man who can possibly save the world.

trailers.name: The Walking Dead: World Beyond Season 1 Comic-Con Trailer | Rotten Tomatoes TV

translations.value: A heroic group of teens sheltered from the dangers of the post-apocalyptic world leave the safety of the only home they have ever known and embark on a cross-country journey to find the one man who can possibly save the world.

info.title: The Walking Dead: World Beyond
info.synopsis: A heroic group of teens sheltered from the dangers of the post-apocalyptic world leave the safety of the only home they have ever known and embark on a cross-country journey to find the one man who can possibly save the world.

episodes.name: Brave
episodes.plot: Iris welcomes an enigmatic ally to their community while Hope questions the visitor's motives. A message upends the sisters' worldview, forcing them to decide between the safety of their home and the uncertainty of the world beyond.

translations.value: Iris welcomes an enigmatic ally to their community while Hope questions the visitor's motives. A message upends the sisters' worldview, forcing them to decide between the safety of their home and the uncertainty of the world beyond.

episodes.name: The Blaze of Gory
episodes.plot: The group adjusts to the reality of life beyond the walls of their community; Iris tries to take over, despite Hope's reservations; Felix and Huck follow the teenagers, while Felix is ​​forced to face unwanted memories.

translations.value: The group adjusts to the reality of life beyond the walls of their community; Iris tries to take over, despite Hope's reservations; Felix and Huck follow the teenagers, while Felix is ​​forced to face unwanted memories.

episodes.name: The Tyger and the Lamb
episodes.plot: Overwhelmed by the past, group members adopt opposite strategies to deal with a huge obstacle; pressure on the group to return home.

translations.value: Overwhelmed by the past, group members adopt opposite strategies to deal with a huge obstacle; pressure on the group to return home.

episodes.name: L'estremità sbagliata di un telescopio
episodes.plot: Per ripararsi da una tempesta, i ragazzi si rifugiano in un liceo abbandonato. Mentre fanno provviste, immaginano come'era la vita a scuola e incontrano nuove minacce, vive e morte.

translations.value: Per ripararsi da una tempesta, i ragazzi si rifugiano in un liceo abbandonato. Mentre fanno provviste, immaginano come'era la vita a scuola e incontrano nuove minacce, vive e morte.

episodes.name: Madman Across the Water
episodes.plot: While the group works together to cross the Mississippi River, a plot to take the teenagers home hits an obstacle; a group member must overcome past traumas to save others from an oncoming threat.

translations.value: While the group works together to cross the Mississippi River, a plot to take the teenagers home hits an obstacle; a group member must overcome past traumas to save others from an oncoming threat.

episodes.name: Shadow Puppets
episodes.plot: When an unexpected newcomer reveals information that can help them reach their destination, the group makes a deal; while some are intrigued by the new arrival, others are suspicious.

translations.value: When an unexpected newcomer reveals information that can help them reach their destination, the group makes a deal; while some are intrigued by the new arrival, others are suspicious.

episodes.name: Truth or Dare
episodes.plot: While the group is looking for something to advance their search, one of them remembers their struggles in the early days of the apocalypse. A game of truth or challenge brings emotions to the surface.

translations.value: While the group is looking for something to advance their search, one of them remembers their struggles in the early days of the apocalypse. A game of truth or challenge brings emotions to the surface.

episodes.name: The Sky Is a Graveyard
episodes.plot: A horrible discovery finds the group at a crossroads and leads one of them to revisit past traumas.

translations.value: A horrible discovery finds the group at a crossroads and leads one of them to revisit past traumas.

episodes.name: La ferita più profonda
episodes.plot: Una serie di imprevisti spinge un membro del gruppo a rivalutare il suo ruolo nella missione. Qualcuno fa una scoperta sorprendente. Una scioccante rivelazione mostra tutto sotto una luce diversa.

translations.value: Una serie di imprevisti spinge un membro del gruppo a rivalutare il suo ruolo nella missione. Qualcuno fa una scoperta sorprendente. Una scioccante rivelazione mostra tutto sotto una luce diversa.

episodes.name: In questa vita
episodes.plot: Un gruppo diviso lotta per riunirsi. Altri puntano ad un bene superiore.

translations.value: Un gruppo diviso lotta per riunirsi. Altri puntano ad un bene superiore.

episodes.name: Konsekans
episodes.plot: Hope's commitment to the future is put to the test, jeopardizing a potential reunion. Iris and Felix meet a new group. Startling revelations are made.

translations.value: Hope's commitment to the future is put to the test, jeopardizing a potential reunion. Iris and Felix meet a new group. Startling revelations are made.

episodes.name: Foothold
episodes.plot: While some members of the group enact a plan to cover their tracks, others attempt to acclimate to their new surroundings.

translations.value: While some members of the group enact a plan to cover their tracks, others attempt to acclimate to their new surroundings.

episodes.name: Ferite d’uscita
episodes.plot: Un tentato imbroglio porta ad una situazione precaria. Mentre Huck prova a riadattarsi alla sua nuova vita, le viene dato un ultimatum.

translations.value: Un tentato imbroglio porta ad una situazione precaria. Mentre Huck prova a riadattarsi alla sua nuova vita, le viene dato un ultimatum.

episodes.name: Famiglia è una parola di quattro lettere
episodes.plot: Sorgono tensioni quando il gruppo mette in dubbio eventi passati e pianifica per il futuro. La situazione si fa esplosiva quando le abilità e la lealtà di qualcuno vengono messe alla prova. Viene fatta una sorprendente scoperta.

translations.value: Famiglia è una parola di quattro lettere

Sorgono tensioni quando il gruppo mette in dubbio eventi passati e pianifica per il futuro. La situazione si fa esplosiva quando le abilità e la lealtà di qualcuno vengono messe alla prova. Viene fatta una sorprendente scoperta.

episodes.name: Quatervois
episodes.plot: Members of the group put a dangerous plan into motion, while others have serious reservations as more startling revelations come to light.

translations.value: Members of the group put a dangerous plan into motion, while others have serious reservations as more startling revelations come to light.

episodes.name: Who Are You?
episodes.plot: A member of the group becomes the target of an investigation. While some grow further apart, others begin to grow closer.

translations.value: A member of the group becomes the target of an investigation. While some grow further apart, others begin to grow closer.

episodes.name: Blood and Lies
episodes.plot: As the group searches for answers, some struggle to find common ground while others question who can be trusted. A shocking message sets a new mission into motion.

translations.value: As the group searches for answers, some struggle to find common ground while others question who can be trusted. A shocking message sets a new mission into motion.

episodes.name: Returning Point
episodes.plot: The group sets a new plan into motion as a relationship is leveraged and a betrayal forces others to take action.

translations.value: The group sets a new plan into motion as a relationship is leveraged and a betrayal forces others to take action.

episodes.name: Death and the Dead
episodes.plot: As the plan continues to unfold, tensions between the group and the CRM come to a dramatic head. While some rush to save an ally, difficult truths are brought to light.

translations.value: As the plan continues to unfold, tensions between the group and the CRM come to a dramatic head. While some rush to save an ally, difficult truths are brought to light.

episodes.name: L’ultima luce
episodes.plot: I membri restanti del gruppo lottano contro i nemici, vivi e morti, nella loro missione per salvare il futuro.

translations.value: I membri restanti del gruppo lottano contro i nemici, vivi e morti, nella loro missione per salvare il futuro.
